entities.name: Rise of Rastafari
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Rastafari movement emerged in 1930s Jamaica following the coronation of Ethiopian Emperor Haile Selassie I, drawing on Marcus Garvey's teachings and African-derived spiritual traditions. Despite persecution, Rastafari grew to become one of Jamaica's most significant cultural and spiritual export
